clue.text: Capital bachelor invested in a high-class race, some say

indicators.note: what some people say out loud, so the built phrase is matched by its sound rather than its spelling

parts.words: bachelor invested in a high-class race
parts.note: B (bachelor) is invested in A, U (upper-class) and DERBY (a race), giving A-BU-DERBY

explanation.surface: Someone describes an upper-crust race with a bachelor taking part, in a posh accent.
explanation.walkthrough: B for bachelor goes after A, then U for upper-class and DERBY, England's best-known horse race at Epsom; 'some say' turns A BU DERBY into the Gulf city by sound.
explanation.definitionFit: Abu Dhabi is the seat of government of the United Arab Emirates, so it is a capital city.

clue.text: Wagnerian flyer's wife and crew?

explanation.definitionFit: Wagner's opera The Flying Dutchman names a ghostly sea captain doomed to sail forever, the flyer of the title.

clue.text: In middle of game he made a sound to attract attention

explanation.definitionFit: The interjection is the polite throat-clearing noise people make to catch someone's notice.

clue.text: Place in office with everything included across way
